cast.name: 埃利赛·楚丘林 Elisey Chuchulin
塔玛拉·阿达莫娃 Tamara Adamova
玛丽亚·亚努舍夫斯卡娅 Mariya Yanushevskaya

introduction: A sensational theatrical event has been thundering in Moscow and St. Petersburg for a year now. Despite the multimillion-dollar ticket price and only one seat in the hall, there is no end to those interested. Of course, because the unique format blurs the boundary between fiction and reality. Here you can be, and not appear. Here you can safely expose the problems of society and be within society. Each performance is a piece of work, created for a specific viewer and thought out to the smallest detail by a whole team of scriptwriters, psychologists and actors under the guidance of a talented director, who has already staged 11 successful performances in a row.
